cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Talk Around the Mess
cards.instruction: Keep attention on minor details so no one addresses the larger responsibility you avoided.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Use black lettering on these moving labels. Pale blue may look pleasant, but it won't be legible from the van.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You haven't packed any of the boxes.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Which is why we can still label them properly. 'Kitchen' at the top, in capitals. Leave room for a contents list.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The van is outside. They want to start loading.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then face every label toward the door. All the same way, please. I'll check the spelling while you turn them.

reason: Remove the container aphorism and explicit empty-box irony; A now directs actual minor labeling work while the unaddressed packing remains visible from B lines.
